name: American Express Business Gold Card

tripDelay.notes: Trip delay insurance triggers after a 12-hour delay (vs. 6 hours on Platinum). Up to $300 per trip. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance is NOT included on the Business Gold Card.

lostBaggage.notes: Baggage insurance plan available when you purchase common carrier tickets with the card. Covers up to $1,250 for carry-on and $500 for checked bags.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the Business Gold Card.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline available for emergency referrals; does NOT cover evacuation costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary rental car insurance. Decline the rental company's CDW.

otherCredits.name: Business Purchases Credit
otherCredits.notes: $20/month statement credit on eligible purchases at FedEx, Grubhub, or Office Supply Stores (select retailers). Enrollment may be required.

otherCredits.name: Hotel Collection Credit
otherCredits.notes: $100 hotel credit per stay at The Hotel Collection properties booked through Amex Travel (minimum 2-night stay). Covers qualifying on-property charges.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Membership Rewards per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 4x on the 2 eligible categories where you spend the most each billing cycle (from eligible list); 3x on flights booked on amextravel.com
rewards.diningRate: 4x if dining is in your top 2 spend categories
otherBonusCategories: 4x Membership Rewards on top 2 eligible categories per billing cycle (automatically adjusts) — eligible categories include: airfare, US advertising in select media, US gas stations, US restaurants, US purchases for shipping, US computer hardware/software/cloud solutions
4x capped at $150,000 in combined purchases per calendar year across the 2 categories, then 1x

pointValue.transferPartners: 1:1 transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners.
